name: ocbc-web-middleware
description: Modern web middleware replacing the CICS BMS 3270 UI (INQSET) for the Investment Portfolio Management System

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c red,cyan "npm run dev -w web-middleware-server" "npm run dev -w web-middleware-client"
scripts.test: npm run test -w web-middleware-server && npm run test -w web-middleware-client
